Sharing: communicating minus isolated accuracy. Hierarchy: hierarchical minus flat location accuracy. Positive and negative values retain their sign.
Common signed color scale: [-0.5861, 0.5861]. Every cell prints its value; panels keep original acuity and colony ordering.

Hatching uses unrounded gaps: |gap| ≤ 0.05. Printed values are rounded; equal printed values can have different hatching. It is not a CI, significance test, unreliability flag or proof of zero effect.
